title: Von-Taube-Weg, Gauting
description:
Room Description
This welcoming private room on Von-Taube-Weg in Gauting provides a comfortable 16 m2 of space. It is furnished with a cozy bed, a spacious wardrobe for ample storage, and a desk ideal for work or study. The apartment, which covers a total of 100 m2, is shared with friendly housemates. It includes central heating and high-speed WiFi, ensuring a warm and well-connected living environment throughout the year.

Common Areas
Residents share access to a modern bathroom and a separate toilet. The fully equipped kitchen is designed for convenience, featuring all necessary appliances for everyday cooking. Additionally, a washing machine is available for shared use, simplifying laundry routines.

Neighborhood
Von-Taube-Weg is located in a charming and tranquil residential area of Gauting. The neighborhood offers a peaceful living environment with excellent access to local amenities. Nearby, you will find various shops, cafes, and restaurants, providing everything you need for daily living.

The Gauting train station is within easy reach, offering convenient public transportation options for commuting to Munich. Additionally, the area is surrounded by green spaces and parks, making it ideal for outdoor activities and relaxation. This location is perfect for those who appreciate a serene setting with easy access to both local conveniences and major city connections.
